## Functions
```{r functions, include = F}
aggregate_data <- function(data, 
                           cols_to_keep, 
                           pop_col,
                           agg_noneuca = TRUE){
  
  
  pop_cols <- c("pop_ACS", "pop_MPI")
  
  data_pop <- data %>% 
    select(-setdiff(pop_cols, pop_col)) %>%
    rename("pop" = !!sym(pop_col))
  
  raw_pop <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region) %>%
    summarize(pop = first(pop), .groups = "drop")
  
  # find geographic keys
  geo_keys <- intersect(cols_to_keep, c("state", "region"))
  
  # aggregate regions if requested
  if(agg_noneuca){
    data_pop <- data_pop %>% 
      mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "Non-EUCA")) %>%
      group_by(pick(-c(n_arrests, pop))) %>%
      summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
                pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
    
    raw_pop <- raw_pop %>% 
      mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "Non-EUCA")) %>%
      group_by(state, region) %>%
      summarize(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
  }
  # population map
  pop_map <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region, pop) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by_at(geo_keys) %>%
    summarize(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
  
   # checksum value
  checksum <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region, pop) %>%
    slice_head(n=1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarize(pop_checksum = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")

  # aggregate arrests, join population back in
  data_pop <- data_pop %>%
    group_by_at(cols_to_keep) %>%
    summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(pop_map, by = geo_keys) %>%
    mutate(ratio = n_arrests/pop*1000,
           log_pop = log(pop))
  
  # checksum
  total_aggregated <- data_pop %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by_at(geo_keys) %>%
    summarize(pop = first(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(pop) %>%
    sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  
  total_checksum <- sum(checksum$pop_checksum, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (!(dplyr::near(total_checksum, total_aggregated))) {
    warning("Checksum Failed!")
  }
  
  return(data_pop)
}

jackknife_supt <- function(fe_fit, model_fml, data, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), extra_fml = NULL, do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = F) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  coef0      <- coef(fe_fit)
  states     <- unique(data$state)
  n_states   <- length(states)

  windows <- setdiff(min(as.numeric(as.character(data$window))):max(as.numeric(as.character(data$window))), -1)

  if (do_se) {
    jackknife_est_matrix <- t(sapply(states, function(dropped_state) {
      sub_data <- subset(data, state != dropped_state)

      if (model_type == "poisson") {
        coef(fepois(model_fml, data = sub_data, offset = extra_fml, cluster = ~state))
      } else {
        coef(feols(model_fml, data = sub_data, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state))
      }
    }))

    # make vcov matrix
    jackknife_est_means <- colMeans(jackknife_est_matrix)
    vcov_unscaled       <- jackknife_est_matrix |>
      scale(center = jackknife_est_means, scale = FALSE) |>
      crossprod()

    scaling_factor <- (n_states - 1) / n_states
    vcov           <- scaling_factor * vcov_unscaled
    se             <- sqrt(diag(vcov))

    # Gaussian sup-t critical value
    # (Montiel Olea & Plagborg-Møller 2019)
    sims <- rmvnorm(10000, sigma = cov2cor(vcov))
    critical_value <- quantile(apply(abs(sims), 1, max), 0.95)

    # exponential transformation if Poisson
    if (model_type == "poisson") {
      supt <- tibble(window = windows,
                     est    = exp(coef0), se = se,
                     lower  = exp(coef0 - critical_value * se),
                     upper  = exp(coef0 + critical_value * se))
    } else {
      supt <- tibble(window = windows,
                     est    = coef0, 
                     se = se,
                     lower  = coef0 - critical_value * se,
                     upper  = coef0 + critical_value * se)
    }
  } else {
    est_val <- if (model_type == "poisson") exp(coef0) else coef0
    supt <- tibble(window = windows, est = est_val, se = 0, lower = est_val, upper = est_val)
  }

  # add the reference period
  ref_val <- if (model_type == "poisson") 1 else 0
  
  output <- supt |>
    bind_rows(tibble(window = -1, est = ref_val, se = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA)) |>
    arrange(window)
  if(do_sensitivity){
    #cat("Raw coef names:\n", names(coef0), "\n")
    clean_windows <- as.numeric(sub(".*window::(-?[0-9]+).*", "\\1", names(coef0)))
    ord            <- order(clean_windows)
    honest_betahat <- coef0[ord]
    honest_sigma   <- vcov[ord, ord]
    clean_windows  <- clean_windows[ord]
    
    numPrePeriods  <- sum(clean_windows < 0)
    numPostPeriods <- sum(clean_windows >= 0)
    
    print(paste0("Pre-periods: ", numPrePeriods))
    print(paste0("Post-periods: ", numPostPeriods))
    l_vec <- rep(1 / numPostPeriods, numPostPeriods)
    # wald
    pre_coef_names <- names(coef0)[1:numPrePeriods]
    wald_test <- fixest::wald(fe_fit, keep = pre_coef_names, vcov = vcov)
    
    print("Wald Pre-Trend Test p-value: ")
    print(wald_test$p)

    delta_rm_results <- HonestDiD::createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
                                    betahat = honest_betahat,
                                    sigma = honest_sigma,
                                    numPrePeriods = numPrePeriods,
                                    numPostPeriods = numPostPeriods,
                                    l_vec = l_vec,
                                    method = "C-LF",
                                    Mbarvec = c(.5, 1, 2.0, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3)
                                    )
    print("M bar Results")
    print(delta_rm_results)
    return(list(output))
  } else{
    return(list(output))
  }
  
}

event_study_plot <- function(estimates, pal, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), baseline = 0) {
  ggplot(estimates, aes(x = window, y = est, group = region, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(0.3), color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.3), color = "black") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(0.3), color = "black") +
    labs(x = "Time Period", y = "Difference in Arrests per 1k\nrelative to EUCA and period -1") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(estimates$window), max(estimates$window), by = 1)) +
    theme_classic()
}

plot_predictions <- function(data, pal, baseline, type = c("linear", "poisson")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  
  if (type == "NOTHING") {
    data <- data %>% group_by(region) %>% mutate(plot_y = n_arrests / n_arrests[window == -1]) %>% ungroup()
    y_lab <- "Arrests per 1k (Relative to window -1)"
  } else {
    data <- data %>% mutate(plot_y = ratio)
    y_lab <- "Arrests per 1k"
  }
  
  plt <- ggplot(data, aes(x = window, y = plot_y, color = region)) +
    geom_point() + geom_line(aes(group = region, y = plot_y)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    labs(x = "Time Period", y = y_lab, title = "") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(data$window), max(data$window), by = 1)) +
    theme_classic() + scale_color_manual(values = pal)
    
  if (type == "poisson") plt + scale_y_log10() + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "grey50")
  else plt + geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, color = "grey50")
}

fit_diffindiff <- function(data, model_fml, extra_fml, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = FALSE) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  int_fml    <- formula(paste(as.character(model_fml)[2], "~ i(window, region, ref2 = 'EUCA') | window"))

  region_coefs <- lapply(setdiff(unique(data$region), "EUCA"), function(cur_reg) {
    d_filt  <- data %>% filter(region %in% c("EUCA", cur_reg))
    is_pois <- model_type == "poisson"
    
    mod     <- if(is_pois) fepois(model_fml, d_filt, offset = extra_fml) else feols(model_fml, d_filt, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state)
    mod_int <- if(is_pois) fepois(int_fml, d_filt, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state) else feols(int_fml, d_filt, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state)

    int_val <- coef(mod_int)[grepl("window::-1:", names(coef(mod_int)))]

    jackknife_supt(mod, model_fml, d_filt, model_type, extra_fml, do_se, do_sensitivity)[[1]] %>%
      mutate(region = cur_reg, period_minus_1_val = int_val)
  })
  
  res <- bind_rows(region_coefs)
  return(res)
}

arrange_fig1 <- function(data_all, data_state, model_fml, extra_fml, offset_fml, title, pal, do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = FALSE, comparison_group = "Non-EUCA") {
  
  pA <- plot_predictions(data_all, pal, 0, "linear") + ylab("Arrests per 1k")+
    labs(color = NULL) +
        theme(legend.direction = "horizontal")
  pB <- event_study_plot(fit_diffindiff(data_state, model_fml, extra_fml, "linear", do_se, do_sensitivity), pal = pal, model_type = "linear", baseline = 0) + 
        ylab(paste0(comparison_group, " - EUCA Arrests\nper 1k Relative to Period -1"))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  pC <- plot_predictions(data_all %>% mutate(ratio = n_arrests), pal, 0, "poisson") + 
        ylab("Total Arrests\n(log scale)") + ylim(1, max(data_all$n_arrests)) + scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma())+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  pD <- event_study_plot(fit_diffindiff(data_state, pois_model_fml, offset_fml, "poisson", do_se, FALSE), pal = pal, model_type = "poisson", baseline = 1) + 
        ylab(paste0(comparison_group, " / EUCA Arrests\nRelative to Period -1"))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  (pA + pB + pC + pD) + 
    plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect", axis_titles = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
    title = title, 
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  )
}
```

## Figures
```{r setup_data, include = F}
#### CONSTANTS ####
model_fml <- as.formula(
  "ratio ~ i(window, region, ref = -1, ref2 = 'EUCA') | region + window"
)
wt_fml <- as.formula("~ pop")
intercept_fml <- as.formula("ratio ~ i(window, region, ref2 = 'EUCA') | window")

pois_model_fml <- as.formula(
  paste0("n_arrests ~ i(window, region, ref = -1, ref2 = 'EUCA') | region + window")
)
offset_fml <- as.formula("~log_pop")
```

```{r, include = F}
make_figure_suite <- function(data, save_folder = "supplement", save_prefix = "", do_sensitivity = F, extend_width = F){
  width = ifelse(extend_width, 12, 6.5)
  # make MPI versions for EUCA vs non-EUCA and by region
  data_state_allregion <- aggregate_data(data, c("region", "window", "state"), "pop_MPI", agg_noneuca = FALSE)
  data_state_nonEUCA <- aggregate_data(data, c("region", "window", "state"), "pop_MPI", agg_noneuca = TRUE)
  data_allregion <- aggregate_data(data, c("region", "window"), "pop_MPI", agg_noneuca = FALSE)
  data_nonEUCA <- aggregate_data(data, c("region", "window"), "pop_MPI", agg_noneuca = TRUE)

  arrange_fig1(data_nonEUCA, data_state_nonEUCA, model_fml, wt_fml, offset_fml, "", pal_euca, do_sensitivity = do_sensitivity)
  ggsave(paste0("../figures/", save_folder, "/", save_prefix, "mpi_denoms_fig1.pdf"), height = 6.5, width = width)

  # make one figure per region
  for (cur_region in setdiff(all_regions, c("EUCA"))){
    data_filtered <- data_allregion %>% filter(region %in% c("EUCA", cur_region))
    data_filtered_state <- data_state_allregion %>% filter(region %in% c("EUCA", cur_region))
    
    arrange_fig1(data_filtered, data_filtered_state, model_fml, wt_fml, offset_fml, "", pal, comparison_group = cur_region, do_sensitivity = F)
    ggsave(paste0("../figures/supplement/", save_prefix, "mpi_denoms_fig1", cur_region, ".pdf"), height = 6.5, width = width)
  }
  
  # make ACS figure for EUCA vs non-EUCA
  data_state_allregion <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("region", "window", "state"), "pop_ACS", agg_noneuca = FALSE)
  data_state_nonEUCA <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("region", "window", "state"), "pop_ACS", agg_noneuca = TRUE)
  data_allregion <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("region", "window"), "pop_ACS", agg_noneuca = FALSE)
  data_nonEUCA <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("region", "window"), "pop_ACS", agg_noneuca = TRUE)
  
  arrange_fig1(data_nonEUCA, data_state_nonEUCA, model_fml, wt_fml, offset_fml, "", pal_euca)
  ggsave(paste0("../figures/supplement/", save_prefix, "acs_denoms_fig1.pdf"), height = 6.5, width = width)
}
```

Test for significance
```{r, sig_test, echo = F}
print("Testing additive model:")
trajectory <- read_csv("../data/processed/glm_trajectory_type_threatlevel_convicted_ACS_MPI.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(region = ifelse(region == "AFRICA", "Africa",
                         ifelse(region == "ASIA", "Asia",
                                ifelse(region == "CARIBBEAN", "Caribbean", region))))

data_state_nonEUCA <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("region", "window", "state"), "pop_MPI", agg_noneuca = T) %>%
  filter(window >= -1) %>%
  mutate(window = ifelse(window < 0, -1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(region, window, pop, state) %>%
  summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests)/n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ratio = n_arrests/pop*1000)

# print("   Pre-treatment rates")
# data_state_nonEUCA %>%
#   mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "nonEUCA")) %>%
#   group_by(window, region) %>%
#   summarize(total_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
#             pop = sum(pop),
#             prop = sum(n_arrests)/sum(pop)*1000, .groups = "drop")

mod <- feols(model_fml, data_state_nonEUCA, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state)

states <- unique(data_state_nonEUCA$state)
n_states <- length(states)

mean_val <- unname(coef(feols(model_fml, data = data_state_nonEUCA, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state)))

jackknife_est_matrix <- t(sapply(states, function(dropped_state) {
  sub_data <- subset(data_state_nonEUCA, state != dropped_state)
  coef(feols(model_fml, data = sub_data, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state))
}))

var = sum((jackknife_est_matrix - mean_val)^2)*(n_states-1)/(n_states )
se = sqrt(var)
z = mean_val/se
print(paste("   p-value: ", pnorm(-abs(z))*2))

print(paste("   Mean effect: ", mean_val))
print(paste("   SE: ", se))
print(paste("   Lower bound: ", mean_val-1.96*se))
print(paste("   Upper bound: ", mean_val+1.96*se))
```
